refs.text_gb: 我们一听见，心就融化了。因你们的缘故，并无一人有胆气；耶和华你们的神本是上天下地的神。
refs.text_big5: 我們一聽見，心就融化了。因你們的緣故，並無一人有膽氣；耶和華你們的神本是上天下地的神。
refs.text_en: When we heard, our hearts melted; and there no longer remained any spirit in any man because of you; for Jehovah your God, He is God in heaven above and upon earth beneath.

refs.text_gb: 那时，以东的族长惊惶，摩押的勇士被战兢抓住，迦南的居民都丧胆了。
refs.text_big5: 那時，以東的族長驚惶，摩押的勇士被戰兢抓住，迦南的居民都喪膽了。
refs.text_en: Then the chiefs of Edom are dismayed; / The mighty men of Moab-- trembling has seized them; / All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.

verses.text_gb: 那时，耶和华对约书亚说，你要制造火石刀，第二次给以色列人行割[Fn1]礼。
verses.text_big5: 那時，耶和華對約書亞說，你要製造火石刀，第二次給以色列人行割[Fn1]禮。
verses.text_en: At that time Jehovah said to Joshua, Make knives of flint, and circumcise again the children of Israel a second time.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那时，耶和华对约书亚说，你要制造火石刀，第二次给以色列人行割礼。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那時，耶和華對約書亞說，你要製造火石刀，第二次給以色列人行割禮。

footnotes.zh: 行割礼的目的是要使神的选民成为新的百姓，好承受神应许之地(参创十七7～12)。给新以色列人行割礼，预表基督借着祂的死所成就的割礼，应用在信徒身上，使他们脱去肉体的身体，好在复活里承受基督作神分给他们的分(西二11～12，一12)。 属灵的割礼是在基督的死里埋葬的延续。借着过约但河，旧以色列人被埋葬，新以色列人出来。这是神所作客观的工作，以色列人仍需要将这工作应用于他们的肉体。他们受割礼，就是实际应用神在过约但河的事上所作的。在新约里，属灵的割礼乃是不断地将基督的死应用于我们的肉体(腓三3，西二11与注)。虽然在事实上，我们已浸入基督的死，与祂一同埋葬并复活(罗六3～4)，但在实行上，我们仍然必须靠着那灵，天天将十字架的割除应用在我们的肉体上(罗八13，加五24)。这是留在基督之死与埋葬里的实际与实行。见加五24注2与罗八13注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 行割禮的目的是要使神的選民成為新的百姓，好承受神應許之地。（參創十七7～12。）給新以色列人行割禮，豫表基督藉著祂的死所成就的割禮，應用在信徒身上，使他們脫去肉體的身體，好在復活裏承受基督作神分給他們的分。（西二11～12，一12。）ˍ屬靈的割禮是在基督的死裏埋葬的延續。藉著過約但河，舊以色列人被埋葬，新以色列人出來。這是神所作客觀的工作，以色列人仍需要將這工作應用於他們的肉體。他們受割禮，就是實際應用神在過約但河的事上所作的。在新約裏，屬靈的割禮乃是不斷的將基督的死應用於我們的肉體。（腓三3，西二11與註。）雖然在事實上，我們已浸入基督的死，與祂一同埋葬並復活，（羅六3～4，）但在實行上，我們仍然必須靠著那靈，天天將十字架的割除應用在我們的肉體上。（羅八13，加五24。）這是留在基督之死與埋葬裏的實際與實行。見加五24註2與羅八13註2。
footnotes.en: 5:2 1 circumcise The purpose of circumcision was to make God's chosen people a new people for the inheriting of God's promised land (cf. Gen. 17:7-12). The circumcising of the new Israel typifies the circumcision of Christ, by His death, applied to the believers in the putting off of the body of the flesh that they may inherit Christ in resurrection as the portion allotted to them by God (Col. 2:11-12; 1:12). Spiritual circumcision is a continuation of the burial in the death of Christ. Through the crossing of the river Jordan, the old Israel was buried and a new Israel came forth. This was an objective work done by God. Israel still needed to apply this work to their flesh. Their being circumcised was their practical application of what God had done in the crossing of the river Jordan. In the New Testament spiritual circumcision is the constant application of Christ's death to our flesh (Phil. 3:3; Col. 2:11 and notes). Although in fact we have been baptized into the death of Christ and have been buried and raised with Him (Rom. 6:3-4), in practicality we still must apply the circumcision of the cross to our flesh by the Spirit day by day (Rom. 8:13; Gal. 5:24). This is the reality and practicality of remaining in the death and burial of Christ. See note Gal. 5:24 2 and note Rom. 8:13 2 .

verses.text_gb: 约书亚就制造了火石刀，在阿拉洛山那里给以色列人行割礼。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞就製造了火石刀，在阿拉洛山那裏給以色列人行割禮。
verses.text_en: And Joshua made knives of flint and circumcised the children of Israel at Gibeath-haaraloth.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚就制造了火石刀，在阿拉洛山那里给以色列人行割礼。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞就製造了火石刀，在阿拉洛山那裏給以色列人行割禮。

verses.text_gb: 约书亚给他们行割礼的缘故，是因为从埃及出来的众民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以后，都死在旷[Cra]野的路上。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞給他們行割禮的緣故，是因為從埃及出來的眾民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以後，都死在曠[Cra]野的路上。
verses.text_en: And this is the reason Joshua circumcised them: All the people who came out of Egypt who were males, all the men of war, died in the wilderness on the way, after they had come out of Egypt.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚给他们行割礼的缘故，是因为从埃及出来的众民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以后，都死在旷野的路上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞給他們行割禮的緣故，是因為從埃及出來的眾民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以後，都死在曠野的路上。

refs.text_gb: 你们的尸首必倒在这旷野，并且你们中间凡被数点的，就是按所计算的数目，从二十岁以上，向我发过怨言的，
refs.text_big5: 你們的屍首必倒在這曠野，並且你們中間凡被數點的，就是按所計算的數目，從二十歲以上，向我發過怨言的，
refs.text_en: Your corpses shall fall in this wilderness, and none of you who were numbered, according to the number you counted from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against Me,

refs.text_gb: 但这些人中，没有一个是摩西和祭司亚伦从前在西乃的旷野所数点的以色列人；
refs.text_big5: 但這些人中，沒有一個是摩西和祭司亞倫從前在西乃的曠野所數點的以色列人；
refs.text_en: But among these there was not one of those numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who had numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

refs.text_gb: 因为耶和华曾论到他们说，他们必要死在旷野。除了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚以外，连一个人也没有存留。
refs.text_big5: 因為耶和華曾論到他們說，他們必要死在曠野。除了耶孚尼的兒子迦勒和嫩的兒子約書亞以外，連一個人也沒有存留。
refs.text_en: For Jehovah had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And not one of them was left, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.

refs.text_gb: 但他们大多数的人，神并不喜悦，因此他们倒毙在旷野。
refs.text_big5: 但他們大多數的人，神並不喜悅，因此他們倒斃在曠野。
refs.text_en: But with most of them God was not well pleased, for they were strewn along in the wilderness.

refs.text_gb: 神四十年之久，又厌烦了谁？岂不是那些犯罪，尸首倒在旷野的人么？
refs.text_big5: 神四十年之久，又厭煩了誰？豈不是那些犯罪，屍首倒在曠野的人麼？
refs.text_en: And with whom was He displeased for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose carcasses fell in the wilderness?

verses.text_gb: 虽然出来的众民都受过割礼，但他们出埃及以后，在旷野的路上所生的众民，都没有受过割礼。
verses.text_big5: 雖然出來的眾民都受過割禮，但他們出埃及以後，在曠野的路上所生的眾民，都沒有受過割禮。
verses.text_en: Although all the people who came out were circumcised, all the people who were born in the wilderness on the way, after the others had come out of Egypt, had not been circumcised.
verses.text_gb_plain: 虽然出来的众民都受过割礼，但他们出埃及以后，在旷野的路上所生的众民，都没有受过割礼。
verses.text_big5_plain: 雖然出來的眾民都受過割禮，但他們出埃及以後，在曠野的路上所生的眾民，都沒有受過割禮。

verses.text_gb: 以色列人在旷野走了四[Cra]十年，直到国民，就是出埃及的兵丁，尽都消灭了，因为他们没有听从耶和华的话；耶和华曾向他们起[Crb]誓，必不容他们看见耶和华向他们列祖起誓要赐给我们的地，就是流[Crc]奶与蜜之地。
verses.text_big5: 以色列人在曠野走了四[Cra]十年，直到國民，就是出埃及的兵丁，盡都消滅了，因為他們沒有聽從耶和華的話；耶和華曾向他們起[Crb]誓，必不容他們看見耶和華向他們列祖起誓要賜給我們的地，就是流[Crc]奶與蜜之地。
verses.text_en: For the children of Israel went for forty years through the wilderness until all the nation, the men of war who had come out of Egypt, were consumed, because they did not listen to the voice of Jehovah, they to whom Jehovah swore that they would not see the land that Jehovah had sworn to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以色列人在旷野走了四十年，直到国民，就是出埃及的兵丁，尽都消灭了，因为他们没有听从耶和华的话；耶和华曾向他们起誓，必不容他们看见耶和华向他们列祖起誓要赐给我们的地，就是流奶与蜜之地。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以色列人在曠野走了四十年，直到國民，就是出埃及的兵丁，盡都消滅了，因為他們沒有聽從耶和華的話；耶和華曾向他們起誓，必不容他們看見耶和華向他們列祖起誓要賜給我們的地，就是流奶與蜜之地。

refs.text_gb: 你们的儿女必在旷野飘流四十年，担当你们不忠信的罪，直到你们的尸首在旷野消灭了。
refs.text_big5: 你們的兒女必在曠野飄流四十年，擔當你們不忠信的罪，直到你們的屍首在曠野消滅了。
refs.text_en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and they shall suffer for your unfaithfulness until your corpses have been consumed in the wilderness.

refs.text_gb: 出埃及后第四十年，十一月初一日，摩西照耶和华所吩咐他一切关于以色列人的话，都告诉他们；
refs.text_big5: 出埃及後第四十年，十一月初一日，摩西照耶和華所吩咐他一切關於以色列人的話，都告訴他們；
refs.text_en: And in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that Jehovah had commanded him for them,

refs.text_gb: 因为耶和华你的神在你手所办的一切事上，已经赐福与你；你走过这大旷野，祂都知道。这四十年，耶和华你的神常与你同在，故此你一无所缺。
refs.text_big5: 因為耶和華你的神在你手所辦的一切事上，已經賜福與你；你走過這大曠野，祂都知道。這四十年，耶和華你的神常與你同在，故此你一無所缺。
refs.text_en: For Jehovah your God has blessed you in all your doings; He knows your journeying through this great wilderness. These forty years Jehovah your God has been with you; you have not lacked a thing.

refs.text_gb: 你也要记念耶和华你的神，这四十年在旷野引导你走的路程，是要苦炼你，试验你，要知道你心内如何，肯守祂的诫命不肯。
refs.text_big5: 你也要記念耶和華你的神，這四十年在曠野引導你走的路程，是要苦煉你，試驗你，要知道你心內如何，肯守祂的誡命不肯。
refs.text_en: And you shall remember all the way that Jehovah your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness in order to humble you and test you to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep His commandments or not.

refs.text_gb: 这四十年，你身上的衣服没有穿破，你的脚也没有走肿。
refs.text_big5: 這四十年，你身上的衣服沒有穿破，你的腳也沒有走腫。
refs.text_en: Your clothing did not wear out from upon you, nor did your foot swell these forty years.

refs.text_gb: 四十年之久，我厌烦那一代的人，说，他们是心里迷糊的百姓，竟不晓得我的法则；
refs.text_big5: 四十年之久，我厭煩那一代的人，說，他們是心裏迷糊的百姓，竟不曉得我的法則；
refs.text_en: For forty years I loathed that generation, / And I said, They are a people who go astray in heart; / And they do not know My ways;

refs.text_gb: 他们断不得看见我起誓要赐给他们祖宗之地；凡藐视我的，一个也不得看见。
refs.text_big5: 他們斷不得看見我起誓要賜給他們祖宗之地；凡藐視我的，一個也不得看見。
refs.text_en: Shall see the land which I swore to give to their fathers, nor shall any of those who despised Me see it.

refs.text_gb: 所以我在怒中起誓，说，他们绝不可进入我的安息！
refs.text_big5: 所以我在怒中起誓，說，他們絕不可進入我的安息！
refs.text_en: Therefore I swore in My anger: / They shall by no means enter into My rest!

refs.text_gb: 我就在怒中起誓说，他们绝不可进入我的安息。”
refs.text_big5: 我就在怒中起誓說，他們絕不可進入我的安息。”
refs.text_en: As I swore in My wrath, They shall not enter into My rest!"

refs.text_gb: 我下来要救他们脱离埃及人的手，领他们从那地出来，上到美好、宽阔、流奶与蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亚摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地方。
refs.text_big5: 我下來要救他們脫離埃及人的手，領他們從那地出來，上到美好、寬闊、流奶與蜜之地，就是到迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地方。
refs.text_en: And I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious land, to a land flowing with milk and honey, to the place of the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites.

verses.text_gb: 他们的子孙，就是耶和华所兴起来接替他们的，约书亚给他们行了割礼；他们本没有受过割礼，因为在路上没有给他们行割礼。

verses.text_en: And their children, whom He had raised up in place of them, these Joshua circumcised; for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.

refs.text_big5: 對他們說，我們不能作這事，把我們的姊妹給沒有受割禮的人為妻，因為那是我們的羞辱。
refs.text_en: And said to them, We are not able to do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised, for that would be a reproach to us.

verses.text_en: And the children of Israel camped in Gilgal; and they held the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening on the plains of Jericho.

verses.text_big5_plain: 以色列人在吉甲安營；正月十四日晚上，他們在耶利哥的平原守逾越節。

footnotes.zh: 守逾越节是记念耶和华救赎以色列人长子脱离死的审判(出十二3～7，11～14)；也是记念耶和华拯救以色列人脱离埃及和法老的暴政(出十四13～30)。守逾越节指明，耶和华怎样拯救以色列人脱离法老和埃及，祂也照样要毁灭迦南各族，拯救以色列人脱离他们。以色列人守逾越节，预表信徒赴主的筵席，记念主是他们的救赎主和救主(太二六26～28)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 守逾越節是記念耶和華救贖以色列人長子脫離死的審判；（出十二3～7，11～14；）也是記念耶和華拯救以色列人脫離埃及和法老的暴政。（出十四13～30。）守逾越節指明，耶和華怎樣拯救以色列人脫離法老和埃及，祂也照樣要毀滅迦南各族，拯救以色列人脫離他們。以色列人守逾越節，豫表信徒赴主的筵席，記念主是他們的救贖主和救主。（太二六26～28。）
footnotes.en: 5:10 1 Passover The Feast of the Passover was held to remember Jehovah's redeeming of Israel from the death-judgment on their firstborn sons (Exo. 12:3-7, 11-14) and also Jehovah's saving of Israel from Egypt and from the tyranny of Pharaoh (Exo. 14:13-30). The keeping of the Passover indicated that just as Jehovah had saved Israel from Pharaoh and Egypt, so He would destroy the tribes of Canaan and deliver Israel from them. Israel's keeping of the Passover typifies the believers' keeping of the Lord's table to remember the Lord as their Redeemer and their Savior (Matt. 26:26-28).

verses.text_big5: 逾越節的次日，他們就喫了那地的出產；正當那日，他們喫了無酵餅和烘的穀。
verses.text_en: And on the day after the Passover, on that very day, they ate of the produce of the land, unleavened cakes and parched grain.

verses.text_gb: 他们吃了那地的出产，当日吗[Fn1][Cra]哪就止住了，以色列人也不再有吗哪了；那一年，他们却吃迦南地的出产。

verses.text_big5_plain: 他們喫了那地的出產，當日嗎哪就止住了，以色列人也不再有嗎哪了；那一年，他們卻喫迦南地的出產。

footnotes.zh: 当百姓开始吃那地的出产，吗哪就止住了，这指明那地的出产乃是吗哪的延续。以色列人在旷野飘流时所吃的吗哪(出十六)，预表基督是神直接赐给祂选民的属天食物，吃的人不需要劳苦。以色列人在迦南争战时神所赐应许之地丰富的出产(申八7～10)，预表基督是赐给信徒那终极完成的生命供应(赐生命的灵—加三14)，需要他们在祂身上劳苦。就如这里的预表所描绘的，我们取得基督这地之后，需要在祂身上劳苦，好从祂有所出产，成为我们的食物，我们的供应。我们吃基督并享受祂作美地的出产时，就被祂构成，在生命、性情和彰显上与基督一式一样(腓一19～21上)。至终，我们对基督作我们的地业、产业的享受，要将我们构成为神的基业、神的珍宝和产业(弗一11～14，18下，参出十九5)。 以色列人在埃及，借着吃埃及的食物(表征属世的事物)，就被构成属世的人。在他们对神救恩的经历里，以色列人在吃的事上经过三个阶段。在第一阶段，他们在埃及吃逾越节的羊羔(出十二)，这使他们得着加力，能走出埃及，而从埃及的世界分别出来。在第二阶段，他们在旷野吃吗哪(出十六)，这使他们被属天的元素重新构成属天的子民。在第三阶段，他们在美地吃丰富的出产，这使他们进一步被构成得胜的子民。以色列人借着享受美地的丰富，就征服迦南地各族，建立神的国，并建造殿作神在地上的居所。以色列人三个吃的阶段，预表信徒借着吃基督而享受基督的三个阶段(约六51～57，林前五7～8，十3～4，腓一19)。借着头两个阶段的吃，信徒得着加力脱离世界，并被基督这属天元素所构成。为着达到神经纶的目标，基督所有的信徒都需要往前，直到他们进入最高的阶段，就是吃基督作美地(包罗万有的灵)丰富的出产，使他们胜过属灵的仇敌，而被建造成为神的居所，并在地上建立神的国。
footnotes.zh_big5: 當百姓開始喫那地的出產，嗎哪就止住了，這指明那地的出產乃是嗎哪的延續。以色列人在曠野飄流時所喫的嗎哪，（出十六，）豫表基督是神直接賜給祂選民的屬天食物，喫的人不需要勞苦。以色列人在迦南爭戰時神所賜應許之地豐富的出產，（申八7～10，）豫表基督是賜給信徒那終極完成的生命供應（賜生命的靈—加三14，）需要他們在祂身上勞苦。就如這裏的豫表所描繪的，我們取得基督這地之後，需要在祂身上勞苦，好從祂有所出產，成為我們的食物，我們的供應。我們喫基督並享受祂作美地的出產時，就被祂構成，在生命、性情和彰顯上與基督一式一樣。（腓一19～21上。）至終，我們對基督作我們的地業、產業的享受，要將我們構成為神的基業、神的珍寶和產業。（弗一11～14，18下，參出十九5。）ˍ以色列人在埃及，藉著喫埃及的食物（表徵屬世的事物，）就被構成屬世的人。在他們對神救恩的經歷裏，以色列人在喫的事上經過三個階段。在第一階段，他們在埃及喫逾越節的羊羔，（出十二，）這使他們得著加力，能走出埃及，而從埃及的世界分別出來。在第二階段，他們在曠野喫嗎哪，（出十六，）這使他們被屬天的元素重新構成屬天的子民。在第三階段，他們在美地喫豐富的出產，這使他們進一步被構成得勝的子民。以色列人藉著享受美地的豐富，就征服迦南地各族，建立神的國，並建造殿作神在地上的居所。以色列人三個喫的階段，豫表信徒藉著喫基督而享受基督的三個階段。（約六51～57，林前五7～8，十3～4，腓一19。）藉著頭兩個階段的喫，信徒得著加力脫離世界，並被基督這屬天元素所構成。為著達到神經綸的目標，基督所有的信徒都需要往前，直到他們進入最高的階段，就是喫基督作美地（包羅萬有的靈）豐富的出產，使他們勝過屬靈的仇敵，而被建造成為神的居所，並在地上建立神的國。
footnotes.en: 5:12 1 manna The ceasing of the manna when the people began to eat the produce of the land indicates that the produce of the land was the continuation of the manna. The manna eaten by Israel in their wandering in the wilderness (Exo. 16) typifies Christ as the heavenly food given directly by God to His chosen people, which requires no labor on the part of the eaters. The rich produce of the promised land given by God to Israel in their fighting in Canaan (Deut. 8:7-10) typifies Christ as the consummated life supply (the life-giving Spirit — Gal. 3:14) given to the believers, which requires them to labor on Him. As portrayed in the typology here, after possessing Christ as the land, we need to labor on Him to produce something of Him that will become our food, our supply. As we eat Christ and enjoy Him as the produce of the good land, we are constituted with Him, being made the same as Christ in life, nature, and expression (Phil. 1:19-21a). Ultimately, our enjoying of Christ as our inheritance, our possession, will constitute us to be God's inheritance, God's treasure and possession (Eph. 1:11-14, 18b; cf. Exo. 19:5). In Egypt, by their eating Egyptian food (signifying worldly things), the children of Israel were constituted to be a worldly people. In their experience of God's salvation Israel passed through three stages in their eating. In the first stage they ate the passover lamb in Egypt (Exo. 12), which strengthened them to walk out of Egypt and to be separated from the Egyptian world. In the second stage they ate the manna in the wilderness (Exo. 16), which reconstituted them with a heavenly element to be a heavenly people. In the third stage they ate the rich produce in the good land, which constituted them further to be an overcoming people. By enjoying the riches of the good land, Israel conquered the tribes in the land, established the kingdom of God, and built up the temple as God's dwelling place on earth. The three stages in Israel's eating typify the three stages of the believers' enjoyment of Christ by eating Him (John 6:51-57; 1 Cor. 5:7-8; 10:3-4; Phil. 1:19). By their eating in the first two stages the believers are energized to leave the world and are constituted with Christ as the heavenly element. To reach the goal of God's economy, all Christ's believers need to progress until they enter into the highest stage of eating Christ as the rich produce of the good land, the all-inclusive Spirit, that they may overcome the spiritual enemies, be built up to be God's dwelling place, and establish God's kingdom on earth.

refs.text_gb: 以色列人吃吗哪共四十年，直到进了有人居住之地，就是迦南地的境界。
refs.text_big5: 以色列人喫嗎哪共四十年，直到進了有人居住之地，就是迦南地的境界。
refs.text_en: And the children of Israel ate the manna forty years, until they came to inhabitable land; they ate the manna until they came to the border of the land of Canaan.

verses.text_gb: 约书亚靠近耶利哥的时候，举目观看；看哪，有一个人[Fn1]手里有拔出来的刀[Cra]，对面站立。约书亚到祂那里，对祂说，你是帮助我们呢，还是帮助我们的敌人？
verses.text_big5: 約書亞靠近耶利哥的時候，舉目觀看；看哪，有一個人[Fn1]手裏有拔出來的刀[Cra]，對面站立。約書亞到祂那裏，對祂說，你是幫助我們呢，還是幫助我們的敵人？
verses.text_en: Now once, when Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked; and behold, there was a man standing opposite him, and His sword was drawn in His hand. And Joshua went to Him and said to Him, Are You for us or for our adversaries?
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚靠近耶利哥的时候，举目观看；看哪，有一个人手里有拔出来的刀，对面站立。约书亚到祂那里，对祂说，你是帮助我们呢，还是帮助我们的敌人？
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞靠近耶利哥的時候，舉目觀看；看哪，有一個人手裏有拔出來的刀，對面站立。約書亞到祂那裏，對祂說，你是幫助我們呢，還是幫助我們的敵人？

footnotes.zh: 这异象乃是向约书亚揭示，基督是耶和华军队的元帅(14)。约书亚是耶和华军队看得见的元帅，而基督是那看不见的元帅。基督是这样一位元帅，为以色列人与迦南七族争战。因此，约书亚需要一直站在圣别的地位上(15)。见罗一2注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這異象乃是向約書亞揭示，基督是耶和華軍隊的元帥。（14。）約書亞是耶和華軍隊看得見的元帥，而基督是那看不見的元帥。基督是這樣一位元帥，為以色列人與迦南七族爭戰。因此，約書亞需要一直站在聖別的地位上。（15。）見羅一2註3。
footnotes.en: 5:13 1 man This vision was an unveiling to Joshua of Christ as the Captain of Jehovah's army (v. 14). Whereas Joshua was the visible captain of Jehovah's army, Christ was the invisible Captain. Christ was such a captain to fight against the seven tribes of Canaan for Israel. Because of this, Joshua needed to stand on the position of sanctification (holiness) all the time (v. 15). See note Rom. 1:2 3 .

refs.text_gb: 驴看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，就从路上转开，跨进田间；巴兰便打驴，要叫它转回路上。
refs.text_big5: 驢看見耶和華的使者站在路上，手裏有拔出來的刀，就從路上轉開，跨進田間；巴蘭便打驢，要叫牠轉回路上。
refs.text_en: And when the donkey saw the Angel of Jehovah standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand, the donkey turned aside out of the way and went into the field. And Balaam struck the donkey to turn her back into the way.

refs.text_gb: 当时，耶和华开了巴兰的眼，他就看见耶和华的使者站在路上，手里有拔出来的刀，巴兰便低头，面伏于地。
refs.text_big5: 當時，耶和華開了巴蘭的眼，他就看見耶和華的使者站在路上，手裏有拔出來的刀，巴蘭便低頭，面伏於地。
refs.text_en: Then Jehovah opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the Angel of Jehovah standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand, and he bowed his head and fell on his face.

verses.text_gb: 祂说，都不是，我现在来，是作耶[Cra]和华军队的元帅。约书亚就面伏于地下拜，说，我主有什么话告诉仆人？
verses.text_big5: 祂說，都不是，我現在來，是作耶[Cra]和華軍隊的元帥。約書亞就面伏於地下拜，說，我主有甚麼話告訴僕人？
verses.text_en: And He said, Neither, but as the Captain of Jehovah's army have I now come. Then Joshua fell to the ground upon his face and worshipped. And he said to Him, What does my Lord speak to His servant?
verses.text_gb_plain: 祂说，都不是，我现在来，是作耶和华军队的元帅。约书亚就面伏于地下拜，说，我主有什么话告诉仆人？
verses.text_big5_plain: 祂說，都不是，我現在來，是作耶和華軍隊的元帥。約書亞就面伏於地下拜，說，我主有甚麼話告訴僕人？

refs.text_gb: 看哪，我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保护你，领你到我所预备的地方去。
refs.text_big5: 看哪，我差遣使者在你前面，在路上保護你，領你到我所豫備的地方去。
refs.text_en: I am now sending an Angel before you to keep you in the way and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

refs.text_gb: 你要在祂面前谨慎，听从祂的话；不可违背祂，因祂必不赦免你们的过犯；因为我的名在祂里面。
refs.text_big5: 你要在祂面前謹慎，聽從祂的話；不可違背祂，因祂必不赦免你們的過犯；因為我的名在祂裏面。
refs.text_en: Be careful before Him, and listen to His voice; do not rebel against Him, for He will not pardon your transgression; for My name is in Him.

refs.text_gb: 你若实在听从祂的话，照着我一切所说的去行，我就向你的仇敌作仇敌，向你的对头作对头。
refs.text_big5: 你若實在聽從祂的話，照著我一切所說的去行，我就向你的仇敵作仇敵，向你的對頭作對頭。
refs.text_en: But if you will indeed listen to His voice and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies and an adversary to your adversaries.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华军队的元帅对约书亚说，把[Cra]你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站的地方是圣[Crb]的。约书亚就照着行了。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華軍隊的元帥對約書亞說，把[Cra]你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站的地方是聖[Crb]的。約書亞就照著行了。
verses.text_en: And the Captain of Jehovah's army said to Joshua, Remove your sandals from your feet, for the place on which you are standing is holy. And Joshua did so.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华军队的元帅对约书亚说，把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站的地方是圣的。约书亚就照着行了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華軍隊的元帥對約書亞說，把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站的地方是聖的。約書亞就照著行了。

refs.text_gb: 神说，不要近前来。把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站的地方乃是圣地；
refs.text_big5: 神說，不要近前來。把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站的地方乃是聖地；
refs.text_en: And He said, Do not come near here. Remove your sandals from your feet, for the place on which you are standing is holy ground.

refs.text_gb: 主对他说，“把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站的地方乃是圣地。
refs.text_big5: 主對他說，“把你腳上的鞋脫下來，因為你所站的地方乃是聖地。
refs.text_en: And the Lord said to him, "Untie the sandals from your feet, for the place on which you stand is holy ground.

refs.text_gb: 我们同祂在圣山的时候，亲自听见这声音从天上发出。
refs.text_big5: 我們同祂在聖山的時候，親自聽見這聲音從天上發出。
refs.text_en: And this voice we heard being borne out of heaven while we were with Him in the holy mountain.

verses.text_gb: 耶利哥的城门因以色列人就关[Fn1]得严紧，无人出入。
verses.text_big5: 耶利哥的城門因以色列人就關[Fn1]得嚴緊，無人出入。
verses.text_en: Now Jericho was shut up so tight because of the children of Israel that no one went out and no one went in.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶利哥的城门因以色列人就关得严紧，无人出入。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶利哥的城門因以色列人就關得嚴緊，無人出入。

footnotes.zh: 耶利哥关得严紧，没有交通，没有进出往来；这表征黑暗的权势，就是在诸天界里邪恶的属灵势力，受到了捆绑(太十二29，弗六12)。见出二三23注1一段。
footnotes.zh_big5: 耶利哥關得嚴緊，沒有交通，沒有進出往來；這表徵黑暗的權勢，就是在諸天界裏邪惡的屬靈勢力，受到了捆綁。（太十二29，弗六12。）見出二三23註1一段。
footnotes.en: 6:1 1 shut The shutting up of Jericho, with no traffic, no coming in or going out, signifies that the powers of darkness, the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenlies, were bound (Matt. 12:29; Eph. 6:12). See note Exo. 23:23 1 , par. 1.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对约书亚说，看哪，我已经把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，并大能的勇士，都交在你手[Cra]中。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對約書亞說，看哪，我已經把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，並大能的勇士，都交在你手[Cra]中。
verses.text_en: And Jehovah said to Joshua, See, I have given Jericho and its king and the mighty men of valor into your hand.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对约书亚说，看哪，我已经把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，并大能的勇士，都交在你手中。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對約書亞說，看哪，我已經把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，並大能的勇士，都交在你手中。

refs.text_gb: 又对约书亚说，耶和华果然将那全地交在我们手中；那地的一切居民，在我们面前都丧胆了。
refs.text_big5: 又對約書亞說，耶和華果然將那全地交在我們手中；那地的一切居民，在我們面前都喪膽了。
refs.text_en: And they said to Joshua, Jehovah has indeed given all the land into our hand; moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt before us.

verses.text_gb: 你们的一切兵丁要围[Cra]绕这城，一日围绕一次，六日都要这样行。
verses.text_big5: 你們的一切兵丁要圍[Cra]繞這城，一日圍繞一次，六日都要這樣行。
verses.text_en: And you shall circle the city, all the men of valor, going around the city one time. Thus shall you do for six days.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们的一切兵丁要围绕这城，一日围绕一次，六日都要这样行。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們的一切兵丁要圍繞這城，一日圍繞一次，六日都要這樣行。

refs.text_gb: 因着信，耶利哥的城墙被围绕七日，就倒塌了。
refs.text_big5: 因著信，耶利哥的城牆被圍繞七日，就倒塌了。
refs.text_en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, having been encircled for a period of seven days.

verses.text_gb: 七个祭司要拿着七个羊[Cra]角号走在约柜前。到第七日，你们要绕城七次，祭司也要吹号。
verses.text_big5: 七個祭司要拿著七個羊[Cra]角號走在約櫃前。到第七日，你們要繞城七次，祭司也要吹號。
verses.text_en: And seven priests shall carry seven trumpets of rams' horns before the Ark. Then on the seventh day you shall circle the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.
verses.text_gb_plain: 七个祭司要拿着七个羊角号走在约柜前。到第七日，你们要绕城七次，祭司也要吹号。
verses.text_big5_plain: 七個祭司要拿著七個羊角號走在約櫃前。到第七日，你們要繞城七次，祭司也要吹號。

refs.text_gb: 嫩的儿子约书亚召了祭司来，对他们说，你们抬起约柜，要有七个祭司拿着七个羊角号走在耶和华的约柜前；
refs.text_big5: 嫩的兒子約書亞召了祭司來，對他們說，你們抬起約櫃，要有七個祭司拿著七個羊角號走在耶和華的約櫃前；
refs.text_en: So Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, Take up the Ark of the Covenant, and let seven priests carry seven trumpets of rams' horns before the Ark of Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 约书亚对百姓说完了话，七个祭司拿着七个羊角号走在耶和华面前吹号；耶和华的约柜在他们后面跟随。
refs.text_big5: 約書亞對百姓說完了話，七個祭司拿著七個羊角號走在耶和華面前吹號；耶和華的約櫃在他們後面跟隨。
refs.text_en: Then when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of rams' horns before Jehovah passed on and blew the trumpets; and the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah went after them.

refs.text_gb: 七个祭司拿着七个羊角号走在耶和华的约柜前，不住地吹号；带兵器的在他们前面走，后队走在耶和华的约柜后面，祭司不住地吹号。
refs.text_big5: 七個祭司拿著七個羊角號走在耶和華的約櫃前，不住的吹號；帶兵器的在他們前面走，後隊走在耶和華的約櫃後面，祭司不住的吹號。
refs.text_en: And the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of rams' horns went before the Ark of Jehovah, continually blowing the trumpets; and the armed men went before them, and the rearguard went after the Ark of Jehovah, the trumpets continually blowing.

refs.text_gb: 到了第七次，祭司吹号的时候，约书亚对百姓说，呼喊吧，因为耶和华已经把城交给你们了。
refs.text_big5: 到了第七次，祭司吹號的時候，約書亞對百姓說，呼喊罷，因為耶和華已經把城交給你們了。
refs.text_en: And at the seventh time the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua said to the people, Shout! For Jehovah has given you the city.

refs.text_gb: 于是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹号。百姓听见号声，便大声呼喊，城墙就塌陷。百姓便上去进城，个个往前直上，将城夺取。
refs.text_big5: 於是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹號。百姓聽見號聲，便大聲呼喊，城牆就塌陷。百姓便上去進城，個個往前直上，將城奪取。
refs.text_en: So the people shouted and the trumpets were blown; and when the people heard the trumpet sound, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat. And the people went up into the city, each straight ahead, and they captured the city.

refs.text_gb: 当年七月初十日，你要大发角声；这是遮罪日，要在遍地发出角声。
refs.text_big5: 當年七月初十日，你要大發角聲；這是遮罪日，要在遍地發出角聲。
refs.text_en: Then you shall sound aloud the ram's horn in the seventh month on the tenth day of the month; on the Day of Expiation you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

refs.text_gb: 于是基甸将三百人分作三队，把角和空瓶交在各人手里，瓶内都有火把。
refs.text_big5: 於是基甸將三百人分作三隊，把角和空瓶交在各人手裏，瓶內都有火把。
refs.text_en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies; and he put trumpets into the hands of them all, as well as empty pitchers, with torches inside the pitchers.

verses.text_gb: 他们吹羊角的声音拖长，你们听见号声时，众百姓要大声呼喊，城墙就必塌陷，百姓个个都要往前直上。
verses.text_big5: 他們吹羊角的聲音拖長，你們聽見號聲時，眾百姓要大聲呼喊，城牆就必塌陷，百姓個個都要往前直上。
verses.text_en: And when they give off the blast of the ram's horn and you hear the trumpet sound, all the people shall shout with a great shout. And the wall of the city will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, each straight ahead.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们吹羊角的声音拖长，你们听见号声时，众百姓要大声呼喊，城墙就必塌陷，百姓个个都要往前直上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們吹羊角的聲音拖長，你們聽見號聲時，眾百姓要大聲呼喊，城牆就必塌陷，百姓個個都要往前直上。

verses.text_gb: 嫩的儿子约书亚召了祭司来，对他们说，你们抬[Cra]起约[Fn1]柜，要有七个祭司拿着七个羊角号走在耶和华的约柜前；
verses.text_big5: 嫩的兒子約書亞召了祭司來，對他們說，你們抬[Cra]起約[Fn1]櫃，要有七個祭司拿著七個羊角號走在耶和華的約櫃前；
verses.text_en: So Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, Take up the Ark of the Covenant, and let seven priests carry seven trumpets of rams' horns before the Ark of Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 嫩的儿子约书亚召了祭司来，对他们说，你们抬起约柜，要有七个祭司拿着七个羊角号走在耶和华的约柜前；
verses.text_big5_plain: 嫩的兒子約書亞召了祭司來，對他們說，你們抬起約櫃，要有七個祭司拿著七個羊角號走在耶和華的約櫃前；

footnotes.zh: 神的百姓不需要作任何事来毁灭耶利哥。他们只需要相信并信靠神，听从以色列军队元帅的指示，并抬着约柜高举基督。这里祭司抬着约柜，表明在属灵的争战里，我们该作的第一件事乃是高举基督。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神的百姓不需要作任何事來毀滅耶利哥。他們只需要相信並信靠神，聽從以色列軍隊元帥的指示，並抬著約櫃高舉基督。這裏祭司抬著約櫃，表明在屬靈的爭戰裏，我們該作的第一件事乃是高舉基督。
footnotes.en: 6:6 1 Ark God's people did not need to do anything to destroy Jericho. They only needed to believe and trust in God, to listen to the instruction from the Captain of the army of Israel, and to exalt Christ by bearing the Ark. The bearing of the Ark here by the priests shows that in the spiritual warfare the first thing we should do is exalt Christ.

refs.text_gb: 吩咐百姓说，你们看见耶和华你们神的约柜，又见祭司利未人抬着，就要从所在的地方起行，跟着约柜去。
refs.text_big5: 吩咐百姓說，你們看見耶和華你們神的約櫃，又見祭司利未人抬著，就要從所在的地方起行，跟著約櫃去。
refs.text_en: And they commanded the people, saying, When you see the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah your God and the Levitical priests bearing it, you shall set out from your place and go after it.

refs.text_gb: 约书亚又对祭司说，你们抬起约柜，在百姓前头过去。于是他们抬起约柜，在百姓前头走。
refs.text_big5: 約書亞又對祭司說，你們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭過去。於是他們抬起約櫃，在百姓前頭走。
refs.text_en: Then Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, Take up the Ark of the Covenant, and cross over before the people. And they took up the Ark of the Covenant and went before the people.

verses.text_gb: 又对百姓说，你们前去绕城，带兵器的要走在耶和华的约柜前。
verses.text_big5: 又對百姓說，你們前去繞城，帶兵器的要走在耶和華的約櫃前。
verses.text_en: And he said to the people, Pass on and circle the city, and let the armed men pass on before the Ark of Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又对百姓说，你们前去绕城，带兵器的要走在耶和华的约柜前。
verses.text_big5_plain: 又對百姓說，你們前去繞城，帶兵器的要走在耶和華的約櫃前。

verses.text_gb: 约书亚对百姓说完了话，七个祭司拿着七个羊角号走在耶和华面前吹号；耶和华的约柜在他们后面跟随。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞對百姓說完了話，七個祭司拿著七個羊角號走在耶和華面前吹號；耶和華的約櫃在他們後面跟隨。
verses.text_en: Then when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of rams' horns before Jehovah passed on and blew the trumpets; and the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah went after them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚对百姓说完了话，七个祭司拿着七个羊角号走在耶和华面前吹号；耶和华的约柜在他们后面跟随。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞對百姓說完了話，七個祭司拿著七個羊角號走在耶和華面前吹號；耶和華的約櫃在他們後面跟隨。

verses.text_gb: 带兵器的走在吹号的祭司前面，后队走在约柜后面，祭司不住地吹号。
verses.text_big5: 帶兵器的走在吹號的祭司前面，後隊走在約櫃後面，祭司不住的吹號。
verses.text_en: And the armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets; and the rearguard went after the Ark, the trumpets continually blowing.
verses.text_gb_plain: 带兵器的走在吹号的祭司前面，后队走在约柜后面，祭司不住地吹号。
verses.text_big5_plain: 帶兵器的走在吹號的祭司前面，後隊走在約櫃後面，祭司不住的吹號。

verses.text_gb: 约书亚吩咐百姓说，你们不[Fn1]可呼喊，不可出声，连一句话也不可出你们的口，等到我叫你们呼喊的日子，那时才可以呼喊。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞吩咐百姓說，你們不[Fn1]可呼喊，不可出聲，連一句話也不可出你們的口，等到我叫你們呼喊的日子，那時纔可以呼喊。
verses.text_en: And Joshua commanded the people, saying, You shall not shout, nor let your voice be heard, nor let a word go forth from your mouth, until the day I say to you, Shout! Then you shall shout.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚吩咐百姓说，你们不可呼喊，不可出声，连一句话也不可出你们的口，等到我叫你们呼喊的日子，那时才可以呼喊。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞吩咐百姓說，你們不可呼喊，不可出聲，連一句話也不可出你們的口，等到我叫你們呼喊的日子，那時纔可以呼喊。

footnotes.zh: 这里说到要保持静默，直到听见吩咐才呼喊，意即以主的方式完成事情，不发表任何想法、意见或感觉。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏說到要保持靜默，直到聽見吩咐纔呼喊，意即以主的方式完成事情，不發表任何想法、意見或感覺。
footnotes.en: 6:10 1 You Here to remain silent until the command was given to shout means to carry out the matter in the Lord's way without expressing any thought, opinion, or feeling.

verses.text_gb: 这样，他使耶和华的约柜绕城，绕了一次；众人回到营里，就在营里住宿。
verses.text_big5: 這樣，他使耶和華的約櫃繞城，繞了一次；眾人回到營裏，就在營裏住宿。
verses.text_en: So he had the Ark of Jehovah circle the city, going around it one time. And they came into the camp and lodged in the camp.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这样，他使耶和华的约柜绕城，绕了一次；众人回到营里，就在营里住宿。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這樣，他使耶和華的約櫃繞城，繞了一次；眾人回到營裏，就在營裏住宿。

verses.text_gb: 约书亚清早起来，祭司又抬起耶和华的约柜。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞清早起來，祭司又抬起耶和華的約櫃。
verses.text_en: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the Ark of Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚清早起来，祭司又抬起耶和华的约柜。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞清早起來，祭司又抬起耶和華的約櫃。

verses.text_gb: 七个祭司拿着七个羊角号走在耶和华的约柜前，不住地吹号；带兵器的在他们前面走，后队走在耶和华的约柜后面，祭司不住地吹号。
verses.text_big5: 七個祭司拿著七個羊角號走在耶和華的約櫃前，不住的吹號；帶兵器的在他們前面走，後隊走在耶和華的約櫃後面，祭司不住的吹號。
verses.text_en: And the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of rams' horns went before the Ark of Jehovah, continually blowing the trumpets; and the armed men went before them, and the rearguard went after the Ark of Jehovah, the trumpets continually blowing.
verses.text_gb_plain: 七个祭司拿着七个羊角号走在耶和华的约柜前，不住地吹号；带兵器的在他们前面走，后队走在耶和华的约柜后面，祭司不住地吹号。
verses.text_big5_plain: 七個祭司拿著七個羊角號走在耶和華的約櫃前，不住的吹號；帶兵器的在他們前面走，後隊走在耶和華的約櫃後面，祭司不住的吹號。

verses.text_gb: 第二日，众人把城绕[Cra]了一次，就回营里去。六日都是这样行。
verses.text_big5: 第二日，眾人把城繞[Cra]了一次，就回營裏去。六日都是這樣行。
verses.text_en: And they circled the city on the second day one time and returned to the camp. This they did for six days.
verses.text_gb_plain: 第二日，众人把城绕了一次，就回营里去。六日都是这样行。
verses.text_big5_plain: 第二日，眾人把城繞了一次，就回營裏去。六日都是這樣行。

refs.text_gb: 因着信，耶利哥的城墙被围绕七日，就倒塌了。
refs.text_big5: 因著信，耶利哥的城牆被圍繞七日，就倒塌了。
refs.text_en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, having been encircled for a period of seven days.

verses.text_gb: 第七日清早，黎明的时候，他们起来，照样绕城七次；唯独这日把城绕了七次。
verses.text_big5: 第七日清早，黎明的時候，他們起來，照樣繞城七次；惟獨這日把城繞了七次。
verses.text_en: Then on the seventh day they rose early, at the break of dawn, and circled the city in the same manner seven times. Only on that day did they circle the city seven times.
verses.text_gb_plain: 第七日清早，黎明的时候，他们起来，照样绕城七次；唯独这日把城绕了七次。
verses.text_big5_plain: 第七日清早，黎明的時候，他們起來，照樣繞城七次；惟獨這日把城繞了七次。

verses.text_gb: 到了第七次，祭司吹号的时候，约书亚对百姓说，呼喊吧，因为耶和华已经把城交给你们了。
verses.text_big5: 到了第七次，祭司吹號的時候，約書亞對百姓說，呼喊罷，因為耶和華已經把城交給你們了。
verses.text_en: And at the seventh time the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua said to the people, Shout! For Jehovah has given you the city.
verses.text_gb_plain: 到了第七次，祭司吹号的时候，约书亚对百姓说，呼喊吧，因为耶和华已经把城交给你们了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 到了第七次，祭司吹號的時候，約書亞對百姓說，呼喊罷，因為耶和華已經把城交給你們了。

verses.text_gb: 这城和其中所有的，都要在耶和华面前毁[Fn1]灭；只有妓女喇合和所有与她在家中的，可以存活，因为她隐[Cra]藏了我们所打发的使者。
verses.text_big5: 這城和其中所有的，都要在耶和華面前毀[Fn1]滅；只有妓女喇合和所有與她在家中的，可以存活，因為她隱[Cra]藏了我們所打發的使者。
verses.text_en: And the city shall be devoted to Jehovah for destruction, it and all that is in it. Only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all who are with her in her house, because she hid the messengers we sent.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这城和其中所有的，都要在耶和华面前毁灭；只有妓女喇合和所有与她在家中的，可以存活，因为她隐藏了我们所打发的使者。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這城和其中所有的，都要在耶和華面前毀滅；只有妓女喇合和所有與她在家中的，可以存活，因為她隱藏了我們所打發的使者。

footnotes.zh: 直译，献上(在此处，以至于毁灭。)
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，獻上（在此處，以至於毀滅。）

refs.text_gb: 女人将二人隐藏起来，回答说，是有人到我这里来；但他们是哪里来的，我并不知道。
refs.text_big5: 女人將二人隱藏起來，回答說，是有人到我這裏來；但他們是那裏來的，我並不知道。
refs.text_en: And the woman took the two men and hid them. And she said, Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.

verses.text_gb: 至于你们，务要谨慎，不可取那当[Cra]灭的物，恐怕你们取了那当灭的物，就使自己成为当灭的，并且叫以色列全营遭[Crb]祸，使全营成为当灭的。
verses.text_big5: 至於你們，務要謹慎，不可取那當[Cra]滅的物，恐怕你們取了那當滅的物，就使自己成為當滅的，並且叫以色列全營遭[Crb]禍，使全營成為當滅的。
verses.text_en: But as for you, keep yourselves from what has been devoted to destruction, lest you devote yourselves to destruction by taking of what has been devoted and you make the camp of Israel something devoted to destruction and bring trouble to it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 至于你们，务要谨慎，不可取那当灭的物，恐怕你们取了那当灭的物，就使自己成为当灭的，并且叫以色列全营遭祸，使全营成为当灭的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 至於你們，務要謹慎，不可取那當滅的物，恐怕你們取了那當滅的物，就使自己成為當滅的，並且叫以色列全營遭禍，使全營成為當滅的。

refs.text_gb: 以色列人犯了罪，违背了我所吩咐他们的约，取了当灭的物；又偷窃，又行诡诈，又把那当灭的物放在他们的物件中。
refs.text_big5: 以色列人犯了罪，違背了我所吩咐他們的約，取了當滅的物；又偷竊，又行詭詐，又把那當滅的物放在他們的物件中。
refs.text_en: Israel has sinned. Indeed they have trespassed My covenant, which I commanded them; indeed they have taken of that which was devoted to destruction; indeed they have stolen; indeed they have been deceptive; indeed they have put it among their goods.

refs.text_gb: 因此，以色列人在仇敌面前站立不住；他们在仇敌面前转背逃跑，是因成了当灭的；你们若不把当灭的物从你们中间毁掉，我就不再与你们同在了。
refs.text_big5: 因此，以色列人在仇敵面前站立不住；他們在仇敵面前轉背逃跑，是因成了當滅的；你們若不把當滅的物從你們中間毀掉，我就不再與你們同在了。
refs.text_en: Thus the children of Israel are not able to stand before their enemies; they turn their backs before their enemies, for they have become something devoted to destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you destroy that which was devoted to destruction from among you.

refs.text_gb: 迦米的儿子是亚割珥，这亚割珥在当灭的物上犯了不忠实的罪，叫以色列人遭祸。
refs.text_big5: 迦米的兒子是亞割珥，這亞割珥在當滅的物上犯了不忠實的罪，叫以色列人遭禍。
refs.text_en: And the son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed by what was accursed.

refs.text_gb: 约书亚说，你为什么叫我们遭祸呢？今日耶和华必叫你遭祸。于是以色列众人用石头打死他和他所有的，并将这一切用火焚烧。
refs.text_big5: 約書亞說，你為甚麼叫我們遭禍呢？今日耶和華必叫你遭禍。於是以色列眾人用石頭打死他和他所有的，並將這一切用火焚燒。
refs.text_en: And Joshua said, Why have you troubled us? Jehovah will trouble you this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones; and they burned them with fire when they had stoned them with stones.

refs.text_gb: 迦米的儿子是亚割珥，这亚割珥在当灭的物上犯了不忠实的罪，叫以色列人遭祸。
refs.text_big5: 迦米的兒子是亞割珥，這亞割珥在當滅的物上犯了不忠實的罪，叫以色列人遭禍。
refs.text_en: And the son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed by what was accursed.

verses.text_gb: 唯有银子、金子、和铜铁的器皿，都要归耶和华为圣，必入耶和华的库中。
verses.text_big5: 惟有銀子、金子、和銅鐵的器皿，都要歸耶和華為聖，必入耶和華的庫中。
verses.text_en: But all the silver and the gold and the vessels of bronze and iron, these are holy to Jehovah; they shall come into the treasury of Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 唯有银子、金子、和铜铁的器皿，都要归耶和华为圣，必入耶和华的库中。
verses.text_big5_plain: 惟有銀子、金子、和銅鐵的器皿，都要歸耶和華為聖，必入耶和華的庫中。

verses.text_gb: 于是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹号。百姓听见号[Fn1]声，便大声呼喊，城[Cra]墙就塌陷。百姓便上去进城，个个往前直上，将城夺取。
verses.text_big5: 於是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹號。百姓聽見號[Fn1]聲，便大聲呼喊，城[Cra]牆就塌陷。百姓便上去進城，個個往前直上，將城奪取。
verses.text_en: So the people shouted and the trumpets were blown; and when the people heard the trumpet sound, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat. And the people went up into the city, each straight ahead, and they captured the city.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹号。百姓听见号声，便大声呼喊，城墙就塌陷。百姓便上去进城，个个往前直上，将城夺取。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹號。百姓聽見號聲，便大聲呼喊，城牆就塌陷。百姓便上去進城，個個往前直上，將城奪取。

footnotes.zh: 以色列人在过约但河之后，在第一次争战中胜过耶利哥，不是凭着争战，乃是借着吹号并呼喊(2～5)；这表征他们相信神指示的话，见证并宣扬神和基督(约柜。)这些是他们能赢得胜利的重要因素。
footnotes.en: 6:20 1 trumpet The victory over Jericho in Israel's first battle after crossing the Jordan was won not by Israel's fighting but by their blowing the trumpets and shouting, signifying the testifying and proclaiming of God with Christ (the Ark) through faith in God's word of instruction (vv. 2-5). These were the vital factors that enabled them to win the victory.

refs.text_gb: 他们吹羊角的声音拖长，你们听见号声时，众百姓要大声呼喊，城墙就必塌陷，百姓个个都要往前直上。

refs.text_gb: 现在我既以恩慈待你们，求你们指着耶和华向我起誓，也要以恩慈待我父家，并给我一个可靠的记号，

refs.text_en: So now, swear to me by Jehovah, I beg you, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father's house; and give me some token of trust,

refs.text_en: That you will preserve my father and my mother and my brothers and my sisters and all that they have, and will deliver our lives from death.

refs.text_gb: 二人对她说，我们情愿替你们死！你若不泄漏我们这件事，耶和华将这地赐给我们的时候，我们必以恩慈信实待你。

refs.text_en: And the men said to her, Our life for yours! If you do not utter anything of this matter concerning us, then when Jehovah gives the land to us, we will deal kindly and faithfully with you.

refs.text_en: And in like manner was not also Rahab the harlot justified by works in that she received the messengers and sent them out by a different way?

refs.text_gb: 祂要将他们的君王交在你手中，你就使他们的名从天下消灭；必无一人能在你面前站立得住，直到你将他们灭绝了。

refs.text_en: And He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall destroy their name from under heaven; no man will be able to stand against you until you destroy them.

refs.text_gb: 你从那城里所夺的财物，都要堆积在城内广场中间，用火将城和其内所夺的财物烧尽，归给耶和华你的神；那城就永为荒堆，不可再建造。

refs.text_en: And all its spoil you shall gather at the middle of its open square, and you shall burn the city and all its spoil with fire wholly to Jehovah your God. And it shall be a mound only forever; it shall not be built again.

refs.text_en: And when she was baptized, as well as her household, she entreated us, saying, If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and abide. And she constrained us.

refs.text_en: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the matter of the devoted thing? But there was wrath upon the whole assembly of Israel, and that one man did not perish alone for his iniquity.

refs.text_en: And the son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed by what was accursed.

verses.text_gb: 约书亚从耶利哥打发人往伯特利东边，靠近伯亚文的艾[Cra]城去；他对他们说，你们上去窥[Fn1][Crb]探那地。那些人就上去窥探艾城。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞從耶利哥打發人往伯特利東邊，靠近伯亞文的艾[Cra]城去；他對他們說，你們上去窺[Fn1][Crb]探那地。那些人就上去窺探艾城。
verses.text_en: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, east of Bethel; and he spoke to them, saying, Go up and spy out the land. So the men went up and spied out Ai.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚从耶利哥打发人往伯特利东边，靠近伯亚文的艾城去；他对他们说，你们上去窥探那地。那些人就上去窥探艾城。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞從耶利哥打發人往伯特利東邊，靠近伯亞文的艾城去；他對他們說，你們上去窺探那地。那些人就上去窺探艾城。

footnotes.zh: 在毁灭耶利哥的事上，不需要争战。但在艾城，由于以色列人失去了主的同在(12下)，约书亚就为着争战打发探子。他们因着愚昧、骄傲和盲目，就轻视仇敌(3)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在毀滅耶利哥的事上，不需要爭戰。但在艾城，由於以色列人失去了主的同在，（12下，）約書亞就為著爭戰打發探子。他們因著愚昧、驕傲和盲目，就輕視仇敵。（3。）
footnotes.en: 7:2 1 spy In the destroying of Jericho, no fighting was needed. But at Ai, because Israel had lost the presence of the Lord (v. 12c), Joshua sent out spies for fighting. Because of their foolishness, pride, and blindness, they despised their enemy (v. 3).

refs.text_gb: 从那里他又迁到伯特利东边的山，支搭帐棚；西边是伯特利，东边是艾；他在那里又为耶和华筑了一座坛，并且呼求耶和华的名。
refs.text_big5: 從那裏他又遷到伯特利東邊的山，支搭帳棚；西邊是伯特利，東邊是艾；他在那裏又為耶和華築了一座壇，並且呼求耶和華的名。
refs.text_en: And he proceeded from there to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; and there he built an altar to Jehovah and called upon the name of Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 当下，嫩的儿子约书亚从什亭暗暗打发两个人作探子，吩咐说，你们去察看那地，特别是耶利哥。于是二人去了，来到一个名叫喇合的妓女家里，就在那里躺卧。
refs.text_big5: 當下，嫩的兒子約書亞從什亭暗暗打發兩個人作探子，吩咐說，你們去察看那地，特別是耶利哥。於是二人去了，來到一個名叫喇合的妓女家裏，就在那裏躺臥。
refs.text_en: Then Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent out from Shittim two men as spies, saying, Go, view the land, especially Jericho. And they went and entered the house of a woman who was a harlot, whose name was Rahab; and they lay down there.

verses.text_gb: 他们回到约书亚那里，对他说，众[Fn1]民不必都上去，大约二三千人上去就能攻下艾城；不必劳累众民都去，因为那里的人少。
verses.text_big5: 他們回到約書亞那裏，對他說，眾[Fn1]民不必都上去，大約二三千人上去就能攻下艾城；不必勞累眾民都去，因為那裏的人少。
verses.text_en: And they returned to Joshua and said to him, Not all the people need go up; let about two or three thousand men go up and strike Ai. Do not make all the people labor there, for the enemies are few.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们回到约书亚那里，对他说，众民不必都上去，大约二三千人上去就能攻下艾城；不必劳累众民都去，因为那里的人少。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們回到約書亞那裏，對他說，眾民不必都上去，大約二三千人上去就能攻下艾城；不必勞累眾民都去，因為那裏的人少。

footnotes.zh: 探子向约书亚的报告，指明以色列人把神放在一边。他们没有求问神该如何攻打艾城；他们忘记神，只知道自己。以色列人凭自己行动，没有寻求主的指引，也没有主的同在。以色列人因着他们的罪与神分开了(11～12)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 探子向約書亞的報告，指明以色列人把神放在一邊。他們沒有求問神該如何攻打艾城；他們忘記神，只知道自己。以色列人憑自己行動，沒有尋求主的指引，也沒有主的同在。以色列人因著他們的罪與神分開了。（11～12。）
footnotes.en: 7:3 1 Not The report of the spies to Joshua indicates that Israel had set God aside. Instead of asking God what they should do against Ai, they forgot God and knew only themselves. Israel acted on their own, without seeking the Lord's direction and without having the Lord's presence. Israel was separated from God because of their sin (vv. 11-12).

verses.text_gb: 于是民中约有三千人上那里去，竟在艾城的人面前逃[Fn1][Cra]跑了。
verses.text_big5: 於是民中約有三千人上那裏去，竟在艾城的人面前逃[Fn1][Cra]跑了。
verses.text_en: So about three thousand men from the people went up there, but they fled before the men of Ai.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是民中约有三千人上那里去，竟在艾城的人面前逃跑了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是民中約有三千人上那裏去，竟在艾城的人面前逃跑了。

footnotes.zh: 以色列人在艾城失败的关键，乃是他们失去神的同在，不再与神是一。这次失败以后，约书亚学了功课，知道要留在约柜前与主同在(6上)。至终，主进来对他说话，告诉他要作什么(10～15)。我们从这记载该学习的属灵功课乃是，我们这些神的子民该一直与我们的神是一；祂不仅在我们中间，也在我们里面，使我们成为有神的人—神人。我们既是神人，就该实行与主是一，与祂同行，与祂同活，并与祂一同行事为人(罗八4，林后二10，加五16，25)。这是基督徒行事为人的路，神儿女争战的路，也是建造基督身体的路。我们若有主的同在，就有智慧、眼光、先见以及对事物内里的认识。主的同在对我们乃是一切。
footnotes.zh_big5: 以色列人在艾城失敗的關鍵，乃是他們失去神的同在，不再與神是一。這次失敗以後，約書亞學了功課，知道要留在約櫃前與主同在。（6上。）至終，主進來對他說話，告訴他要作甚麼。（10～15。）我們從這記載該學習的屬靈功課乃是，我們這些神的子民該一直與我們的神是一；祂不僅在我們中間，也在我們裏面，使我們成為有神的人—神人。我們既是神人，就該實行與主是一，與祂同行，與祂同活，並與祂一同行事為人。（羅八4，林後二10，加五16，25。）這是基督徒行事為人的路，神兒女爭戰的路，也是建造基督身體的路。我們若有主的同在，就有智慧、眼光、先見、以及對事物內裏的認識。主的同在對我們乃是一切。
footnotes.en: 7:4 1 fled The secret of Israel's defeat at Ai was that they had lost God's presence and were no longer one with God. After this defeat Joshua learned the lesson of staying with the Lord before the Ark (v. 6a). Eventually, the Lord came in to speak to him and to tell him what to do (vv. 10-15). The spiritual lesson to be learned from this account is that we, the people of God, should always be one with our God, who is not only among us but also in us, making us men with God — God-men. As God-men, we should practice being one with the Lord, walking with Him, living with Him, and having our entire being with Him (Rom. 8:4; 2 Cor. 2:10; Gal. 5:16, 25). This is the way to walk as a Christian, to fight as a child of God, and to build up the Body of Christ. If we have the Lord's presence, we have wisdom, insight, foresight, and the inner knowledge concerning things. The Lord's presence is everything to us.

refs.text_gb: 我要向你们变脸，你们就要败在仇敌面前；恨恶你们的，必辖管你们；无人追赶，你们却要逃跑。
refs.text_big5: 我要向你們變臉，你們就要敗在仇敵面前；恨惡你們的，必轄管你們；無人追趕，你們卻要逃跑。
refs.text_en: And I will set My face against you, and you will be struck down before your enemies; and those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华必使你在仇敌面前被击败，你从一条路出去攻击他们，必在他们面前从七条路逃跑。你必成为地上万国战惊的因由。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華必使你在仇敵面前被擊敗，你從一條路出去攻擊他們，必在他們面前從七條路逃跑。你必成為地上萬國戰驚的因由。
refs.text_en: Jehovah will cause you to be struck down before your enemies; on one road you will go out against them, but on seven roads you will flee before them. And you will be a source of shuddering to all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.text_gb: 艾城的人击杀了他们约三十六人，从城门前追赶他们，直到示巴琳，在下坡击败他们；众民的心就融[Cra]化如水。
verses.text_big5: 艾城的人擊殺了他們約三十六人，從城門前追趕他們，直到示巴琳，在下坡擊敗他們；眾民的心就融[Cra]化如水。
verses.text_en: And the men of Ai struck some of them, about thirty-six men; and they pursued them from before the gate unto Shebarim and struck them on the slope. And the heart of the people melted and became like water.
verses.text_gb_plain: 艾城的人击杀了他们约三十六人，从城门前追赶他们，直到示巴琳，在下坡击败他们；众民的心就融化如水。
verses.text_big5_plain: 艾城的人擊殺了他們約三十六人，從城門前追趕他們，直到示巴琳，在下坡擊敗他們；眾民的心就融化如水。

refs.text_gb: 我们要上哪里去呢？我们的弟兄使我们的心融化，说，那地的民比我们又大又高，城邑又宽大又坚固，高得顶天；我们在那里还看到亚衲人的子孙。
refs.text_big5: 我們要上那裏去呢？我們的弟兄使我們的心融化，說，那地的民比我們又大又高，城邑又寬大又堅固，高得頂天；我們在那裏還看到亞衲人的子孫。
refs.text_en: Where shall we go up? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, saying, The people are greater and taller than we; the cities are big and fortified up to heaven; and furthermore we have seen the children of the Anakim there.

refs.text_gb: 然而，同我上去的众弟兄使百姓的心融化；但我专一跟从耶和华我的神。
refs.text_big5: 然而，同我上去的眾弟兄使百姓的心融化；但我專一跟從耶和華我的神。
refs.text_en: However my brothers who went up with me made the people's heart melt, but I fully followed Jehovah my God.

refs.text_gb: 对他们说，我知道耶和华已经把这地赐给你们，并且因你们的缘故我们都惊慌了，这地的一切居民，在你们面前也都丧胆了；
refs.text_big5: 對他們說，我知道耶和華已經把這地賜給你們，並且因你們的緣故我們都驚慌了，這地的一切居民，在你們面前也都喪膽了；
refs.text_en: And she said to the men, I know that Jehovah has given you the land, and that the dread of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt before you.

verses.text_gb: 约书亚便撕裂衣服，他和以色列的长老在[Cra]耶和华的约柜前，面伏于地，直到晚上；他们也把尘土撒在头上。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞便撕裂衣服，他和以色列的長老在[Cra]耶和華的約櫃前，面伏於地，直到晚上；他們也把塵土撒在頭上。
verses.text_en: And Joshua rent his clothes and fell to the ground upon his face before the Ark of Jehovah until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust upon their heads.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚便撕裂衣服，他和以色列的长老在耶和华的约柜前，面伏于地，直到晚上；他们也把尘土撒在头上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞便撕裂衣服，他和以色列的長老在耶和華的約櫃前，面伏於地，直到晚上；他們也把塵土撒在頭上。

refs.text_gb: 把烧香用的金坛放在见证的柜前，挂上帐幕的门帘。
refs.text_big5: 把燒香用的金壇放在見證的櫃前，掛上帳幕的門簾。
refs.text_en: And you shall put the golden altar for incense before the Ark of the Testimony and set up the screen of the entrance to the tabernacle.

refs.text_gb: 所罗门醒了，不料是个梦。他就到耶路撒冷去，站在耶和华的约柜前，献燔祭和平安祭，又为他的众臣仆设摆筵席。
refs.text_big5: 所羅門醒了，不料是個夢。他就到耶路撒冷去，站在耶和華的約櫃前，獻燔祭和平安祭，又為他的眾臣僕設擺筵席。
refs.text_en: Then Solomon awoke, and behold, it was a dream. And he went to Jerusalem and stood before the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah, and he offered up burnt offerings and offered peace offerings and made a feast for all his servants.

verses.text_gb: 约书亚说，哀哉！主耶和华啊，你为什么竟领这百姓过约但河，将我们交在亚摩利人的手中，使我们灭亡呢？我们不如住在约但河那边倒好。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞說，哀哉！主耶和華阿，你為甚麼竟領這百姓過約但河，將我們交在亞摩利人的手中，使我們滅亡呢？我們不如住在約但河那邊倒好。
verses.text_en: And Joshua said, Ah, Lord Jehovah! Why have You brought this people over the Jordan at all? To give us over into the hand of the Amorites and cause us to perish? If only we had been content to dwell across the Jordan!
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚说，哀哉！主耶和华啊，你为什么竟领这百姓过约但河，将我们交在亚摩利人的手中，使我们灭亡呢？我们不如住在约但河那边倒好。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞說，哀哉！主耶和華阿，你為甚麼竟領這百姓過約但河，將我們交在亞摩利人的手中，使我們滅亡呢？我們不如住在約但河那邊倒好。

verses.text_gb: 主啊，以色列人既在仇敌面前转背逃跑，我还有什么可说的呢？
verses.text_big5: 主阿，以色列人既在仇敵面前轉背逃跑，我還有甚麼可說的呢？
verses.text_en: O Lord, what can I say after Israel has turned its back before its enemies?
verses.text_gb_plain: 主啊，以色列人既在仇敌面前转背逃跑，我还有什么可说的呢？
verses.text_big5_plain: 主阿，以色列人既在仇敵面前轉背逃跑，我還有甚麼可說的呢？

verses.text_gb: 迦南人和这地一切的居民听见了，就必围困我们，将我们的名[Cra]从地上剪除。那时你为你的大名要怎样行呢？
verses.text_big5: 迦南人和這地一切的居民聽見了，就必圍困我們，將我們的名[Cra]從地上剪除。那時你為你的大名要怎樣行呢？
verses.text_en: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and they will surround us and cut off our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?
verses.text_gb_plain: 迦南人和这地一切的居民听见了，就必围困我们，将我们的名从地上剪除。那时你为你的大名要怎样行呢？
verses.text_big5_plain: 迦南人和這地一切的居民聽見了，就必圍困我們，將我們的名從地上剪除。那時你為你的大名要怎樣行呢？

refs.text_gb: 他们说，来吧，我们将他们除灭，使他们不再成国，使以色列的名不再被人记念。
refs.text_big5: 他們說，來罷，我們將他們除滅，使他們不再成國，使以色列的名不再被人記念。
refs.text_en: They have said, Come and let us destroy them from being a nation, / That the name of Israel may no longer be remembered.

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对约书亚说，起来，你为何这样面伏于地？
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對約書亞說，起來，你為何這樣面伏於地？
verses.text_en: Then Jehovah said to Joshua, Rise up! Why have you fallen upon your face?
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对约书亚说，起来，你为何这样面伏于地？
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對約書亞說，起來，你為何這樣面伏於地？

verses.text_gb: 以[Fn1]色列人犯了罪，违背了我所吩咐他们的约，取了当[Cra]灭的物；又偷窃，又行诡诈，又把那当灭的物放在他们的物件中。
verses.text_big5: 以[Fn1]色列人犯了罪，違背了我所吩咐他們的約，取了當[Cra]滅的物；又偷竊，又行詭詐，又把那當滅的物放在他們的物件中。
verses.text_en: Israel has sinned. Indeed they have trespassed My covenant, which I commanded them; indeed they have taken of that which was devoted to destruction; indeed they have stolen; indeed they have been deceptive; indeed they have put it among their goods.
verses.text_gb_plain: 以色列人犯了罪，违背了我所吩咐他们的约，取了当灭的物；又偷窃，又行诡诈，又把那当灭的物放在他们的物件中。
verses.text_big5_plain: 以色列人犯了罪，違背了我所吩咐他們的約，取了當滅的物；又偷竊，又行詭詐，又把那當滅的物放在他們的物件中。

footnotes.zh: 虽然这罪是亚干个人所犯(20)，却影响了神全体的百姓。因着这罪，神离开以色列人，从他们收回祂的同在(12下)。这是约书亚和以色列众人在攻击艾城时，变得愚昧、骄傲和盲目的原因。
footnotes.zh_big5: 雖然這罪是亞干個人所犯，（20，）卻影響了神全體的百姓。因著這罪，神離開以色列人，從他們收回祂的同在。（12下。）這是約書亞和以色列眾人在攻擊艾城時，變得愚昧、驕傲和盲目的原因。
footnotes.en: 7:11 1 Israel Although this sin was committed by an individual, Achan (v. 20), it affected the entire body of God's people. Because of this sin God stayed away from Israel, withdrawing His presence from them (v. 12c). This was the reason that Joshua and all the children of Israel became foolish, proud, and blind in attacking Ai.

refs.text_gb: 这城和其中所有的，都要在耶和华面前毁灭；只有妓女喇合和所有与她在家中的，可以存活，因为她隐藏了我们所打发的使者。
refs.text_big5: 這城和其中所有的，都要在耶和華面前毀滅；只有妓女喇合和所有與她在家中的，可以存活，因為她隱藏了我們所打發的使者。
refs.text_en: And the city shall be devoted to Jehovah for destruction, it and all that is in it. Only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all who are with her in her house, because she hid the messengers we sent.

refs.text_gb: 至于你们，务要谨慎，不可取那当灭的物，恐怕你们取了那当灭的物，就使自己成为当灭的，并且叫以色列全营遭祸，使全营成为当灭的。
refs.text_big5: 至於你們，務要謹慎，不可取那當滅的物，恐怕你們取了那當滅的物，就使自己成為當滅的，並且叫以色列全營遭禍，使全營成為當滅的。
refs.text_en: But as for you, keep yourselves from what has been devoted to destruction, lest you devote yourselves to destruction by taking of what has been devoted and you make the camp of Israel something devoted to destruction and bring trouble to it.

refs.text_gb: 被取的人有当灭的物在他那里，他和他所有的必被火焚烧；因他违背了耶和华的约，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。
refs.text_big5: 被取的人有當滅的物在他那裏，他和他所有的必被火焚燒；因他違背了耶和華的約，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。
refs.text_en: And he who is taken with that which was devoted to destruction shall be burned with fire, he and all that belongs to him, because he has trespassed the covenant of Jehovah and because he has committed folly in Israel.

verses.text_gb: 因此，以色列人在仇敌面前站[Cra]立不住；他们在仇敌面前转背逃跑，是因成了当灭的；你们若不把当灭的物从你们中间毁掉，我就不再与你们同在了。
verses.text_big5: 因此，以色列人在仇敵面前站[Cra]立不住；他們在仇敵面前轉背逃跑，是因成了當滅的；你們若不把當滅的物從你們中間毀掉，我就不再與你們同在了。
verses.text_en: Thus the children of Israel are not able to stand before their enemies; they turn their backs before their enemies, for they have become something devoted to destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you destroy that which was devoted to destruction from among you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因此，以色列人在仇敌面前站立不住；他们在仇敌面前转背逃跑，是因成了当灭的；你们若不把当灭的物从你们中间毁掉，我就不再与你们同在了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因此，以色列人在仇敵面前站立不住；他們在仇敵面前轉背逃跑，是因成了當滅的；你們若不把當滅的物從你們中間毀掉，我就不再與你們同在了。

refs.text_gb: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，把他们交在抢夺者手中，这些人就抢夺他们；祂又将他们交付在四围仇敌的手中，甚至他们在仇敌面前再不能站立得住。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，把他們交在搶奪者手中，這些人就搶奪他們；祂又將他們交付在四圍仇敵的手中，甚至他們在仇敵面前再不能站立得住。
refs.text_en: Then the anger of Jehovah burned against Israel, and He delivered them into the hands of plunderers; and they plundered them. And He sold them into the hand of their enemies around them, and they were no longer able to stand before their enemies.

verses.text_gb: 你起来，叫百姓分[Cra]别为圣，说，你们要使自己分别为圣，预备明天，因为耶和华以色列的神这样说，以色列啊，你们中间有当灭的物，非等到你们把那当灭的物从你们中间除掉，你们在仇敌面前必站立不住。
verses.text_big5: 你起來，叫百姓分[Cra]別為聖，說，你們要使自己分別為聖，豫備明天，因為耶和華以色列的神這樣說，以色列阿，你們中間有當滅的物，非等到你們把那當滅的物從你們中間除掉，你們在仇敵面前必站立不住。
verses.text_en: Rise up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow; for thus says Jehovah the God of Israel, There is something devoted to destruction among you, O Israel; you will not be able to stand before your enemies until you remove that which was devoted to destruction from among you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你起来，叫百姓分别为圣，说，你们要使自己分别为圣，预备明天，因为耶和华以色列的神这样说，以色列啊，你们中间有当灭的物，非等到你们把那当灭的物从你们中间除掉，你们在仇敌面前必站立不住。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你起來，叫百姓分別為聖，說，你們要使自己分別為聖，豫備明天，因為耶和華以色列的神這樣說，以色列阿，你們中間有當滅的物，非等到你們把那當滅的物從你們中間除掉，你們在仇敵面前必站立不住。

refs.text_gb: 约书亚对百姓说，你们要使自己分别为圣，因为明天耶和华必在你们中间行奇事。
refs.text_big5: 約書亞對百姓說，你們要使自己分別為聖，因為明天耶和華必在你們中間行奇事。
refs.text_en: And Joshua said to the people, Sanctify yourselves, for tomorrow Jehovah will do wondrous things in your midst.

verses.text_gb: 到了早晨，你们要按着支派近[Cra]前来；耶和华所取的支派，要按着家族近前来；耶和华所取的家族，要按着家室近前来；耶和华所取的家室，要按着男丁，一个一个地近前来。
verses.text_big5: 到了早晨，你們要按著支派近[Cra]前來；耶和華所取的支派，要按著家族近前來；耶和華所取的家族，要按著家室近前來；耶和華所取的家室，要按著男丁，一個一個的近前來。
verses.text_en: Therefore in the morning you shall be brought near by your tribes; and the tribe which Jehovah takes shall draw near family by family; and the family which Jehovah takes shall draw near house by house; and the house which Jehovah takes shall draw near warrior by warrior.
verses.text_gb_plain: 到了早晨，你们要按着支派近前来；耶和华所取的支派，要按着家族近前来；耶和华所取的家族，要按着家室近前来；耶和华所取的家室，要按着男丁，一个一个地近前来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 到了早晨，你們要按著支派近前來；耶和華所取的支派，要按著家族近前來；耶和華所取的家族，要按著家室近前來；耶和華所取的家室，要按著男丁，一個一個的近前來。

refs.text_gb: 于是，撒母耳使以色列众支派近前来掣签，就掣出便雅悯支派来；
refs.text_big5: 於是，撒母耳使以色列眾支派近前來掣籤，就掣出便雅憫支派來；
refs.text_en: So Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken.

verses.text_gb: 被取的人有当灭的物在他那里，他和他所有的必被火焚烧；因他违背了耶和华的约，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。
verses.text_big5: 被取的人有當滅的物在他那裏，他和他所有的必被火焚燒；因他違背了耶和華的約，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。
verses.text_en: And he who is taken with that which was devoted to destruction shall be burned with fire, he and all that belongs to him, because he has trespassed the covenant of Jehovah and because he has committed folly in Israel.
verses.text_gb_plain: 被取的人有当灭的物在他那里，他和他所有的必被火焚烧；因他违背了耶和华的约，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。

verses.text_gb: 于是约书亚清早起来，使以色列人按着支派近前来，取[Fn1]出来的是犹大支派；
verses.text_big5: 於是約書亞清早起來，使以色列人按著支派近前來，取[Fn1]出來的是猶大支派；
verses.text_en: So Joshua rose early in the morning and brought Israel near by their tribes, and the tribe of Judah was taken.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是约书亚清早起来，使以色列人按着支派近前来，取出来的是犹大支派；
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是約書亞清早起來，使以色列人按著支派近前來，取出來的是猶大支派；

footnotes.zh: 以色列人找出犯罪的人(16～18)，是借着大祭司决断胸牌上的乌陵和土明(出二八30与注)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 以色列人找出犯罪的人，（16～18，）是藉著大祭司決斷胸牌上的烏陵和土明。（出二八30與註。）

verses.text_gb: 他使犹大支[Fn1]派近前来，就取了谢拉家族；使谢拉家族，按着男丁，一个一个地近前来，取出来的是撒底；

verses.text_en: And he brought the family of Judah near, and the family of the Zerahites was taken. And he brought the family of the Zerahites near warrior by warrior, and Zabdi was taken.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他使犹大支派近前来，就取了谢拉家族；使谢拉家族，按着男丁，一个一个地近前来，取出来的是撒底；

footnotes.zh: 直译，家族。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，家族。

verses.text_gb: 使撒底的家室，按着男丁，一个一个地近前来，就取出犹大支派的人谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干。
verses.text_big5: 使撒底的家室，按著男丁，一個一個的近前來，就取出猶大支派的人謝拉的曾孫，撒底的孫子，迦米的兒子亞干。
verses.text_en: And he brought the house of Zabdi near warrior by warrior, and Achan the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
verses.text_gb_plain: 使撒底的家室，按着男丁，一个一个地近前来，就取出犹大支派的人谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干。
verses.text_big5_plain: 使撒底的家室，按著男丁，一個一個的近前來，就取出猶大支派的人謝拉的曾孫，撒底的孫子，迦米的兒子亞干。

verses.text_gb: 约书亚对亚干说，我儿，我劝你将[Cra]荣耀归给耶和华以色列的神，向祂认[Fn1]罪，将你所作的事告诉我，不要向我隐瞒。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞對亞干說，我兒，我勸你將[Cra]榮耀歸給耶和華以色列的神，向祂認[Fn1]罪，將你所作的事告訴我，不要向我隱瞞。
verses.text_en: And Joshua said to Achan, My son, give glory to Jehovah the God of Israel, and make confession to Him. And tell me what you have done; do not hide anything from me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚对亚干说，我儿，我劝你将荣耀归给耶和华以色列的神，向祂认罪，将你所作的事告诉我，不要向我隐瞒。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞對亞干說，我兒，我勸你將榮耀歸給耶和華以色列的神，向祂認罪，將你所作的事告訴我，不要向我隱瞞。

footnotes.zh: 或，赞美。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，讚美。
footnotes.en: 7:19 1 make Or, give praise.

refs.text_gb: 所以当制造你们痔疮的像，和你们那些毁坏地的老鼠的像，并要归荣耀给以色列的神，或者祂向你们和你们的神，并你们的地，把手放轻些。
refs.text_big5: 所以當製造你們痔瘡的像，和你們那些毀壞地的老鼠的像，並要歸榮耀給以色列的神，或者祂向你們和你們的神，並你們的地，把手放輕些。
refs.text_en: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that devastate the land, and you shall give glory to the God of Israel; perhaps He will lighten His hand on you and your gods and your land.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华你们的神未使黑暗来到，你们的脚未在昏暗山上绊跌之先，当将荣耀归给祂；你们盼望光，祂却使光变为死荫，成为幽暗。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華你們的神未使黑暗來到，你們的腳未在昏暗山上絆跌之先，當將榮耀歸給祂；你們盼望光，祂卻使光變為死蔭，成為幽暗。
refs.text_en: Give glory to Jehovah your God, / Before He brings darkness, / And before your feet stumble on the twilight mountains; / And you will look for light, / But He will turn it into a shadow of death / And make it deep darkness.

refs.text_gb: 所以法利赛人第二次叫了那从前瞎眼的人来，对他说，你当将荣耀归与神，我们知道这人是个罪人。
refs.text_big5: 所以法利賽人第二次叫了那從前瞎眼的人來，對他說，你當將榮耀歸與神，我們知道這人是個罪人。
refs.text_en: Therefore a second time they called the man who had been blind, and said to him, Give glory to God; we know that this man is a sinner.

verses.text_en: Then Achan answered Joshua and said, It is true; I have sinned against Jehovah the God of Israel; and this is what I did:

verses.text_big5: 我在所奪的財物中，看見一件美好的示[Fn1][Cra]拿衣服、二百舍客勒銀子、一條金子重五十舍客勒，我貪圖這些物件，便拿去了。這些物件現今藏在我帳棚內的地裏，銀子在衣服底下。
verses.text_en: When I saw among the spoil a beautiful mantle of Shinar and two hundred shekels of silver and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. And now they are hidden in the earth in my tent, with the silver under it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我在所夺的财物中，看见一件美好的示拿衣服、二百舍客勒银子、一条金子重五十舍客勒，我贪图这些物件，便拿去了。这些物件现今藏在我帐棚内的地里，银子在衣服底下。

refs.text_gb: 他国的起头是巴别、以力、亚甲、甲尼，都在示拿地。
refs.text_big5: 他國的起頭是巴別、以力、亞甲、甲尼，都在示拿地。
refs.text_en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel and Erech and Accad and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

refs.text_gb: 主将犹大王约雅敬，并神殿中的一些器皿交付他手，他就把这些器皿带到示拿地，他神的庙里，带进他神的库中。
refs.text_big5: 主將猶大王約雅敬，並神殿中的一些器皿交付他手，他就把這些器皿帶到示拿地，他神的廟裏，帶進他神的庫中。
refs.text_en: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim the king of Judah into his hand with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he brought them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god, and he brought the vessels into the treasury of his god.

verses.text_gb: 约书亚就打发使者跑到亚干的帐棚里。那件衣服果然藏在他帐棚内，银子在底下。

verses.text_en: And Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent. And there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.

verses.text_gb: 他们就把那些物件从帐棚里取出来，拿到约书亚和以色列众人那里，摆在耶和华面前。
verses.text_big5: 他們就把那些物件從帳棚裏取出來，拿到約書亞和以色列眾人那裏，擺在耶和華面前。
verses.text_en: And they took the things from within the tent and brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel, and spread them out before Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们就把那些物件从帐棚里取出来，拿到约书亚和以色列众人那里，摆在耶和华面前。

verses.text_gb: 约书亚和以色列众人把谢拉的曾孙亚[Cra]干和那银子、那件衣服、那条金子，并亚干的儿子、女儿、牛、驴、羊、帐棚、以及他所有的，都带上亚割谷去。

refs.text_gb: 从前谢拉的曾孙亚干，岂不是在那当灭的物上犯了不忠实的罪么？那时就有忿怒临到以色列全会众；因他罪孽而死的，还不只他一人。
refs.text_big5: 從前謝拉的曾孫亞干，豈不是在那當滅的物上犯了不忠實的罪麼？那時就有忿怒臨到以色列全會眾；因他罪孽而死的，還不只他一人。
refs.text_en: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the matter of the devoted thing? But there was wrath upon the whole assembly of Israel, and that one man did not perish alone for his iniquity.

verses.text_gb: 约书亚说，你为什么叫我们遭[Cra]祸呢？今日耶和华必叫你遭祸。于是以色列众人用石[Crb]头打死他和他所有的，并将这一切用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5: 約書亞說，你為甚麼叫我們遭[Cra]禍呢？今日耶和華必叫你遭禍。於是以色列眾人用石[Crb]頭打死他和他所有的，並將這一切用火焚燒。
verses.text_en: And Joshua said, Why have you troubled us? Jehovah will trouble you this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones; and they burned them with fire when they had stoned them with stones.
verses.text_gb_plain: 约书亚说，你为什么叫我们遭祸呢？今日耶和华必叫你遭祸。于是以色列众人用石头打死他和他所有的，并将这一切用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 約書亞說，你為甚麼叫我們遭禍呢？今日耶和華必叫你遭禍。於是以色列眾人用石頭打死他和他所有的，並將這一切用火焚燒。

refs.text_gb: 至于你们，务要谨慎，不可取那当灭的物，恐怕你们取了那当灭的物，就使自己成为当灭的，并且叫以色列全营遭祸，使全营成为当灭的。
refs.text_big5: 至於你們，務要謹慎，不可取那當滅的物，恐怕你們取了那當滅的物，就使自己成為當滅的，並且叫以色列全營遭禍，使全營成為當滅的。
refs.text_en: But as for you, keep yourselves from what has been devoted to destruction, lest you devote yourselves to destruction by taking of what has been devoted and you make the camp of Israel something devoted to destruction and bring trouble to it.

refs.text_gb: 迦米的儿子是亚割珥，这亚割珥在当灭的物上犯了不忠实的罪，叫以色列人遭祸。
refs.text_big5: 迦米的兒子是亞割珥，這亞割珥在當滅的物上犯了不忠實的罪，叫以色列人遭禍。
refs.text_en: And the son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed by what was accursed.

refs.text_gb: 你还要对以色列人说，凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的儿女献给摩洛的，必要被处死；本地的人要用石头把他打死。
refs.text_big5: 你還要對以色列人說，凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的兒女獻給摩洛的，必要被處死；本地的人要用石頭把他打死。
refs.text_en: Moreover you shall say to the children of Israel, Anyone of the children of Israel or of the sojourners who sojourn in Israel who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

refs.text_gb: 把那咒诅圣名的人带到营外，叫听见的人都按手在他头上；全会众要用石头打死他。
refs.text_big5: 把那咒詛聖名的人帶到營外，叫聽見的人都按手在他頭上；全會眾要用石頭打死他。
refs.text_en: Bring forth the one who has cursed outside the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the assembly stone him.

refs.text_gb: 你要用石头打死他，因为他想要勾引你离开那将你从埃及地，从为奴之家领出来的耶和华你的神。
refs.text_big5: 你要用石頭打死他，因為他想要勾引你離開那將你從埃及地，從為奴之家領出來的耶和華你的神。
refs.text_en: And you shall stone him with stones so that he dies, because he sought to force you away from Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the slave house.

refs.text_gb: 你就要将行这恶事的男人或女人拉到城门那里，用石头将他们打死。
refs.text_big5: 你就要將行這惡事的男人或女人拉到城門那裏，用石頭將他們打死。
refs.text_en: Then you shall bring out that man or that woman who has done this evil thing, to your gates, that very man or woman, and you shall stone them with stones so that they die.

verses.text_gb: 众人在亚干身上堆成一大堆石头，直存到今日。于是耶和华转[Cra]意，不发祂的烈怒。因此那地方名叫亚[Fn1]割谷，直到今日。
verses.text_big5: 眾人在亞干身上堆成一大堆石頭，直存到今日。於是耶和華轉[Cra]意，不發祂的烈怒。因此那地方名叫亞[Fn1]割谷，直到今日。
verses.text_en: Then they erected over him a great heap of stones, which is there to this day; and Jehovah turned from the fierceness of His anger. Therefore the name of that place is called the Valley of Achor to this day.

refs.text_gb: 那当毁灭的物，连一点都不可粘你的手，好叫耶和华转意不发烈怒，却向你施怜悯，怜恤你，照祂向你列祖所起的誓，使你人数增多；
refs.text_big5: 那當毀滅的物，連一點都不可粘你的手，好叫耶和華轉意不發烈怒，卻向你施憐憫，憐恤你，照祂向你列祖所起的誓，使你人數增多；
refs.text_en: And nothing of what has been cursed shall cling to your hand, in order that Jehovah may turn from His burning anger and show you tenderness and be compassionate to you and multiply you as He swore to your fathers,

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对约书亚说，不[Cra]要惧怕，也不要惊惶。你率领一切兵丁，起来上艾城去；看哪，我已经把艾城的王和他的民、他的城、并他的地，都交在你手[Crb]里。
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對約書亞說，不[Cra]要懼怕，也不要驚惶。你率領一切兵丁，起來上艾城去；看哪，我已經把艾城的王和他的民、他的城、並他的地，都交在你手[Crb]裏。
verses.text_en: Then Jehovah said to Joshua, Do not be afraid or dismayed. Take all the people of war with you, and rise and go up to Ai. See, I have given the king of Ai and his people and his city and his land into your hand.
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对约书亚说，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。你率领一切兵丁，起来上艾城去；看哪，我已经把艾城的王和他的民、他的城、并他的地，都交在你手里。
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對約書亞說，不要懼怕，也不要驚惶。你率領一切兵丁，起來上艾城去；看哪，我已經把艾城的王和他的民、他的城、並他的地，都交在你手裏。

refs.text_gb: 我岂没有吩咐你么？你当刚强壮胆，不要惧怕，也不要惊惶；因为你无论往哪里去，耶和华你的神必与你同在。
refs.text_big5: 我豈沒有吩咐你麼？你當剛強壯膽，不要懼怕，也不要驚惶；因為你無論往那裏去，耶和華你的神必與你同在。
refs.text_en: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and take courage; do not be afraid or dismayed. For Jehovah your God is with you wherever you go.

refs.text_gb: 又对约书亚说，耶和华果然将那全地交在我们手中；那地的一切居民，在我们面前都丧胆了。
refs.text_big5: 又對約書亞說，耶和華果然將那全地交在我們手中；那地的一切居民，在我們面前都喪膽了。
refs.text_en: And they said to Joshua, Jehovah has indeed given all the land into our hand; moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt before us.

verses.text_gb: 你怎样待[Cra]耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也当照样待艾城和艾城的王；只是城内所夺[Crb]的财物和牲畜，你们可以取为自己的掠物。你要在城后设下攻城的伏兵。
verses.text_big5: 你怎樣待[Cra]耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也當照樣待艾城和艾城的王；只是城內所奪[Crb]的財物和牲畜，你們可以取為自己的掠物。你要在城後設下攻城的伏兵。
verses.text_en: And you shall do to Ai and to its king as you did to Jericho and to its king; except its spoil and its cattle you shall take for your plunder. Set an ambush for the city behind it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你怎样待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也当照样待艾城和艾城的王；只是城内所夺的财物和牲畜，你们可以取为自己的掠物。你要在城后设下攻城的伏兵。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你怎樣待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也當照樣待艾城和艾城的王；只是城內所奪的財物和牲畜，你們可以取為自己的掠物。你要在城後設下攻城的伏兵。

refs.text_gb: 又将城中所有的，不拘男女老少，牛羊和驴，都用刀杀尽。
refs.text_big5: 又將城中所有的，不拘男女老少，牛羊和驢，都用刀殺盡。
refs.text_en: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city with the edge of the sword: both men and women, young and old, and oxen and sheep and donkeys.

refs.text_gb: 唯有妇女、孩子、牲畜、和城内的一切，就是所有的掠物，你可以夺为己有；你可以享用从仇敌所取的掠物，那是耶和华你神所赐给你的。
refs.text_big5: 惟有婦女、孩子、牲畜、和城內的一切，就是所有的掠物，你可以奪為己有；你可以享用從仇敵所取的掠物，那是耶和華你神所賜給你的。
refs.text_en: But the women and the little ones and the beasts and all that is in the city, that is, all its spoil, you shall take as your plunder; and you shall enjoy the spoil of your enemies, which Jehovah your God has given you.

refs.text_gb: 唯独城中的牲畜和财物，以色列人都取为自己的掠物，是照耶和华所吩咐约书亚的话。
refs.text_big5: 惟獨城中的牲畜和財物，以色列人都取為自己的掠物，是照耶和華所吩咐約書亞的話。
refs.text_en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for themselves as plunder, according to the word of Jehovah, which He commanded Joshua.

verses.text_en: So Joshua rose up with all the people of war to go up to Ai. And Joshua chose thirty thousand men, mighty men of valor, and sent them out by night.

verses.text_en: And I and all the people who are with me will draw near to the city. Then when they come forth to meet us, as it was the first time, we will flee before them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我与我所带领的众民要向城进迫。城里的人像初次出来攻击我们的时候，我们就在他们面前逃跑。

verses.text_en: And they will come out after us until we have drawn them out from the city, for they will say, They are fleeing before us as they did the first time. Thus we will flee before them.

verses.text_big5: 你們就從埋伏的地方起來，奪取那城，因為耶和華你們的神必把城交在你們手裏。

refs.text_en: And he proceeded from there to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; and there he built an altar to Jehovah and called upon the name of Jehovah.

refs.text_en: And he called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz previously.
